name: Fetch the PDF of a cited work
route: POST /api/cross-citations/queries/{query_id}/fetch-pdfs {enabled, auto_extract_references?} (seed pool → collector batch) · POST /api/fetch-pool/{corpus_result_id}/claim | prepare | upload · GET /api/fetch-pool/{corpus_result_id}/pdf-url · POST /api/thinker-studies/{study_id}/phase3/acquire
cost_note: the mini-PC collector's nominal tariff; the local fetch agent and Sci-Hub / Anna's Archive routes are free
side_effects: a PDF on the corpus row (identity-audited); auto-read chains bibliography extraction
gated_by: query automation must be enabled for auto-read
